name: miliarium-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the Miliarium iOS app — Firestore triggers, push dispatch, cascade cleanup.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --config ../firebase.json --project demo-miliarium "jest --config jest.integration.config.js --runInBand"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
